auth_whatsapp_otp.description: Phone/WhatsApp OTP flow. Generates 6-digit OTP, stores in phone_otps, sends via Meta Cloud API using credentials from lms_settings (whatsapp_phone_number_id, whatsapp_access_token, whatsapp_api_version). Invalidates prior unused OTPs for the same phone. Returns 503 if credentials not configured.
auth_whatsapp_otp.v029_compatibility_note: Source uses $app, $http.send, Record, routerAdd — standard PocketBase hook API. No JSVM-specific binding noted beyond $app.findFirstRecordByFilter and $app.findRecordsByFilter. Recommend testing on v0.29.3 to confirm these bindings are present.

security_notes.otp_not_in_response: OTP code is NOT returned in the HTTP response body — stored only in phone_otps table
security_notes.prior_invalidation: Invalidates all prior unused OTPs for the same phone on each new request
security_notes.meta_failure_behavior: Returns 500 with error detail if Meta API call fails; OTP record already written before the call — possible issue: OTP stored but not delivered
security_notes.credentials_check: Returns 503 if whatsapp_phone_number_id or whatsapp_access_token absent from lms_settings

emergency_users_hardening.description: Role escalation protection for PATCH to users collection. Fires on onRecordUpdateRequest for 'users'. Allows pass-through if: body does not contain 'role'; or caller is application superadmin (role='superadmin'); or caller is native _superusers. Blocks all other role writes with 403.
emergency_users_hardening.expected_status_after_removal: 200 (role write would succeed without hook — regression)
emergency_users_hardening.coverage: UPDATE path only. CREATE path (POST /api/collections/users/records) is NOT intercepted. This is security gap S-1.
emergency_users_hardening.v029_compatibility_note: Uses e.auth.collection().name binding documented as v0.28.4. Has a catch block that logs and blocks if binding unavailable (safe failure). Must be verified on v0.29.3. T-NSU-HOOK-BEHAVIOR tests this path.

whatsapp_webhook.description: WhatsApp inbound webhook handler. Processes status updates and inbound messages from Meta. Uses dedup_key to prevent duplicate processing.
whatsapp_webhook.note: Harness must NOT send real WhatsApp webhook events to this endpoint even in isolated mode.

ai_chat.description: Gemini AI chat endpoint. Reads Gemini API key from ai_settings collection.

hooks_absent.onboarding: No onboarding.pb.js found in pb_hooks/. R18 assumed this hook existed. Removed from HOOK_SRC_PATHS.
hooks_absent.alias_intercept: No alias_intercept.pb.js found in pb_hooks/. R18 assumed this hook existed. Removed from HOOK_SRC_PATHS. Alias-account intercept behavior is either not implemented or handled by another mechanism (NEEDS-EXTERNAL).

HOOK_OTP_PHONE_ROUTE.note: NOT PocketBase email OTP. This is the custom hook-registered route for phone/WhatsApp OTP.

HOOK_OTP_MOCK_CONTROL_ROUTE.note: This route is defined for the local OTP test adapter only. It MUST NOT be added to production hooks. The operator must deploy the OTP test adapter hook file (release1b_otp_test_adapter.pb.js) to the isolated harness hooks directory before T-CONCURRENCY-OTP-SEND can run. See §6 of operator instructions.

local_adapter_design.purpose: Replaces direct Meta Cloud API calls with a controllable in-process mock

routes.POST /api/auth/request-whatsapp-otp: Same signature as production. Generates OTP, stores in phone_otps, records send-attempt in mock state. Never calls Meta.
routes.POST /api/test/otp-control: Resets mock state, injects failure modes, reads send-attempt count. Accessible only from localhost. Body: { action: 'reset'|'set_failure'|'get_state' }.
routes.GET /api/test/otp-read/{phone}: Returns latest unused OTP code for phone (for harness OTP retrieval without real delivery). Localhost only.

local_adapter_design.never_logs: OTP values, raw phone numbers, raw provider responses
local_adapter_design.rate_limit_behavior: Records attempt count per phone per window; honors the same invariants as production would
local_adapter_design.isolation_guarantee: Adapter file is copied to isolated hooks dir only; never to production hooks dir

endpoint_auth_policy.value: Anonymous — no authentication required for POST /api/auth/request-whatsapp-otp
endpoint_auth_policy.source: auth_whatsapp_otp.pb.js — no auth check before processing request body
endpoint_auth_policy.note: Phone-first registration flow: caller provides phone number, receives OTP via WhatsApp, then verifies. No auth token required for request or verify steps.

rate_limit_invariants.current_behavior: Production hook invalidates prior OTPs for same phone but does not enforce a rate limit or quota. No 429 response is produced. Rate-limit enforcement must be added or confirmed absent.
required_before_test: Whether a rate limit is implemented or planned
If rate limited: allowed-send count per window, window duration, expected HTTP status (429 or other)
Allowed concurrent active OTP count per phone
